messages:
Olivia: incident-bot just flagged a spike in 5xxs for prompt-route /new-endpoint (v2). Canary at 15% is throwing errors :rotating_light:
Incident Bot: ANOMALY DETECTED service=prompt-route/v2 metric=5xx_rate baseline=0.02 current=0.11 window=4m
Raj: paging @Maria (oncall) 1: can you take this? looks like the new endpoint rollout
Maria: got the page. pulling logs now. what percent is the canary at? @Raj
Raj: set to 15% at 2026-03-15T14:03:00Z, prod still on v1 route
Sam: seeing repeated OOMKilled and model-init timeouts in v2 pods, some responses truncated or with JSON escaping errors
Kevin: support: 4 customers reported malformed/truncated completions. raising low-level tickets for each account
Maria: runbook check: if canary 5xx > 4x baseline or if customer-facing errors, flip the ff. which flag is this?
Raj: experiment.prompt_route_new_v2
Maria: ok i'm going to disable that flag now to force traffic back to v1. tagging @ops-deploy for execution
Ops-Deploy: standing by, ready to execute on approval
Maria: approved. running toggle now:
Maria: ```
# disable the canary routing flag
redwood-ops featureflag toggle --name experiment.prompt_route_new_v2 --env prod --state off --actor maria
# verify status
redwood-ops featureflag status --name experiment.prompt_route_new_v2 --env prod
```
Maria: toggle returned OK. expecting traffic to shift off v2 within 20s
Incident Bot: CONFIG CHANGE record: experiment.prompt_route_new_v2 set=off by Maria at 2026-03-15T14:10:47Z
Sam: tailing logs now. quick counts:
Sam: ```
# errors in last 1m
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/prompt-route-v2 --since=1m | grep ERROR | wc -l
# before toggle ~140, after toggle ~6
```
Olivia: good. can infra confirm there are no active sticky sessions or LB caches still routing a subset to v2? @Ops-Deploy @Eng-Infra
Ops-Deploy: running checks on LB sticky rules and proxy cache TTLs now
Maria: curl health checks show pods healthy but gateway layer returns routed-to-v1 404s as expected (routing layer honoring ff)
Kevin: support update: notified impacted customers of rollback and next steps; they asked for RCA ETA
Olivia: timeline so far: 14:03 canary rollout -> 14:07 spike detected -> 14:10 flag disabled -> 14:12 traffic normalized
Raj: next: collect diagnostic artifacts, preserve canary logs, do not re-enable flag until eng-runtime & eng-ml sign off
Sam: saving diagnostic bundle:
Sam: ```
redwood-ops collect-diagnostics --service prompt-route/v2 --since 14:00 --out s3://redwood-diagnostics/prompt_v2_20260315.tgz
```
Maria: note to teams: do not re-enable experiment.prompt_route_new_v2 until we validate model init memory and kernel compatibility on the GPU fleet; staging re-run required
Olivia: assigning follow-ups: ENG-RUNTIME (memory profile + kernel mismatch), ENG-ML (model startup), ENG-INFRA (LB/proxy validation)
Ops-Deploy: creating rollback ticket (deploy-id: dpl-20260315-4210) and linking artifacts
Incident Bot: PAGER: oncall acknowledged by Maria; incident severity=SEV2; page duration=41m
Kevin: support will keep customers informed; will escalate if any of them demand faster ETA
Sam: uploaded bundle to s3://redwood-diagnostics/prompt_v2_20260315.tgz
Maria: filing a short incident summary and opening a postmortem placeholder PM-2026-03-prompt-route-v2-canary for root cause and rollback plan
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE status=mitigated severity=SEV2 assignee=Olivia
Maria: handing incident off to next oncall: Maria -> Olivia for monitoring window of 2h
Olivia: taking handoff and will watch metrics for 2h. ping me for any regressions. thanks team :thumbsup:
Kevin: customers acknowledged the rollback message and are awaiting RCA
Raj: thanks everyone for quick action. will book a 45m triage in 90 minutes to plan staged rollout and tests
Maria: closing active mitigation steps in this thread. monitoring channel remains open for the watch window
Olivia: noted. good job on the rapid kill and comms. we'll capture remediation and gating criteria in the postmortem.
